    import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
    import type { UnitCatalog } from "./unitCatalogService";

    const invokeMock = vi.hoisted(() => vi.fn());
    vi.mock("@tauri-apps/api/core", () => ({ invoke: invokeMock }));

    import { acceptedUnits, describeUnitBasis, loadUnitCatalog, unitCatalogEntryForSymbol } from "./unitCatalogService";

    const catalogFixture: UnitCatalog = {
      schema_version: "0.1.0",
      catalog_id: "unit-system:dec-018-si-dual-display",
      decision_basis: "DEC-018",
      calculation_basis: "si_canonical",
      storage_convention: "entered_units_preserved",
      entry_count: 5,
      entries: [
        {
          unit_id: "unit:meter",
          symbol: "m",
          dimension_id: "length",
          canonical: true,
          transform_kind: "identity",
          factor_representation: "1 m/m, SI canonical identity",
          offset_representation: null,
          provenance: "si_canonical",
          review_status: "accepted"
        },
        {
          unit_id: "unit:inch",
          symbol: "in",
          dimension_id: "length",
          canonical: false,
          transform_kind: "multiplicative",
          factor_representation: "25.4 mm/in, exact by definition",
          offset_representation: null,
          provenance: "exact_public_definition",
          review_status: "accepted"
        },
        {
          unit_id: "unit:degree_fahrenheit",
          symbol: "degF",
          dimension_id: "temperature",
          canonical: false,
          transform_kind: "affine",
          factor_representation: "5/9 K/degF interval, exact by definition",
          offset_representation: "(459.67 * 5/9) K at 0 degF, exact by definition",
          provenance: "exact_public_definition",
          review_status: "accepted"
        },
        {
          unit_id: "unit:pascal",
          symbol: "Pa",
          dimension_id: "pressure",
          canonical: true,
          transform_kind: "identity",
          factor_representation: "1 Pa/Pa, SI canonical identity",
          offset_representation: null,
          provenance: "si_canonical",
          review_status: "accepted"
        },
        {
          unit_id: "unit:pound_force",
          symbol: "lbf",
          dimension_id: "force",
          canonical: false,
          transform_kind: "multiplicative",
          factor_representation:
            "0.45359237 kg/lb * 9.80665 m/s^2 per lbf, conventional standard gravity",
          offset_representation: null,
          provenance: "conventional_public_constant",
          review_status: "accepted"
        }
      ],
      boundary: {
        source: "core/units open_pipe_stress_units catalog",
        protected_content_included: false,
        private_project_data_included: false,
        professional_approval_claimed: false,
        code_compliance_claimed: false
      }
    };

    afterEach(() => {
      invokeMock.mockReset();
      delete (window as unknown as Record<string, unknown>).__TAURI_INTERNALS__;
    });

    describe("unitCatalogService", () => {
      it("reports an explicit browser-preview unavailable route instead of synthesizing units", async () => {
        const route = await loadUnitCatalog();

        expect(route.route).toBe("unavailable_browser_preview");
        if (route.route !== "unavailable_browser_preview") throw new Error("expected browser-unavailable route");
        expect(route.diagnostic).toContain("UNIT-CATALOG-DESKTOP-ONLY");
        expect(invokeMock).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      });

      it("loads the reviewed Tauri unit catalog command in desktop mode", async () => {
        (window as unknown as Record<string, unknown>).__TAURI_INTERNALS__ = {};
        invokeMock.mockResolvedValue(catalogFixture);

        const route = await loadUnitCatalog();

        expect(route.route).toBe("tauri_unit_catalog");
        expect(invokeMock).toHaveBeenCalledWith("get_unit_catalog");
        if (route.route !== "tauri_unit_catalog") throw new Error("expected Tauri catalog route");
        expect(route.catalog.decision_basis).toBe("DEC-018");
        expect(route.catalog.storage_convention).toBe("entered_units_preserved");
        expect(route.catalog.boundary.protected_content_included).toBe(false);
        expect(route.catalog.boundary.professional_approval_claimed).toBe(false);
        expect(route.catalog.entries.find((entry) => entry.unit_id === "unit:inch")?.factor_representation).toContain(
          "25.4 mm/in"
        );
        expect(route.catalog.entries.find((entry) => entry.unit_id === "unit:degree_fahrenheit")?.offset_representation)
          .toContain("459.67");
        expect(route.catalog.entries.find((entry) => entry.unit_id === "unit:pound_force")?.provenance).toBe(
          "conventional_public_constant"
        );
        expect(acceptedUnits(route.catalog)).toHaveLength(route.catalog.entry_count);
      });

      it("describes model-unit fields against the reviewed catalog without inventing browser units", () => {
        const tauriRoute = { route: "tauri_unit_catalog" as const, catalog: catalogFixture };

        expect(unitCatalogEntryForSymbol(catalogFixture, "m", "length")?.unit_id).toBe("unit:meter");
        expect(unitCatalogEntryForSymbol(catalogFixture, "Pa", "stress")?.unit_id).toBe("unit:pascal");

        expect(describeUnitBasis(tauriRoute, "m", "length")).toMatchObject({
          label: "m, DEC-018 canonical",
          source: "dec018_catalog_accepted",
          unit_id: "unit:meter",
          review_status: "accepted",
          canonical: true
        });
        expect(describeUnitBasis(tauriRoute, "Pa", "stress")).toMatchObject({
          label: "Pa, DEC-018 canonical",
          source: "dec018_catalog_accepted",
          unit_id: "unit:pascal"
        });
        expect(describeUnitBasis(tauriRoute, "C", "temperature")).toMatchObject({
          label: "C, catalog mismatch",
          source: "dec018_catalog_miss",
          unit_id: null
        });
        expect(
          describeUnitBasis(
            {
              route: "unavailable_browser_preview",
              diagnostic: "UNIT-CATALOG-DESKTOP-ONLY: browser preview does not synthesize a fallback catalog."
            },
            "m",
            "length"
          )
        ).toMatchObject({
          label: "m, model metadata",
          source: "browser_preview_model_metadata",
          unit_id: null
        });
      });
    });

## Component: apps/desktop/src/services/unitCatalogService.ts

    import { invoke } from "@tauri-apps/api/core";

    export type UnitCatalogEntry = {
      unit_id: string;
      symbol: string;
      dimension_id: string;
      canonical: boolean;
      transform_kind: "identity" | "multiplicative" | "affine";
      factor_representation: string;
      offset_representation: string | null;
      provenance:
        | "si_canonical"
        | "exact_public_definition"
        | "conventional_public_constant"
        | "project_governed_decision";
      review_status: "accepted" | "pending" | "rejected" | "quarantined" | "TBD";
    };

    export type UnitCatalogBoundary = {
      source: string;
      protected_content_included: boolean;
      private_project_data_included: boolean;
      professional_approval_claimed: boolean;
      code_compliance_claimed: boolean;
    };

    export type UnitCatalog = {
      schema_version: string;
      catalog_id: string;
      decision_basis: string;
      calculation_basis: "si_canonical";
      storage_convention: "entered_units_preserved";
      entry_count: number;
      entries: UnitCatalogEntry[];
      boundary: UnitCatalogBoundary;
    };

    export type UnitCatalogRoute =
      | { route: "tauri_unit_catalog"; catalog: UnitCatalog }
      | { route: "unavailable_browser_preview"; diagnostic: string };

    export type UnitBasisDisplay = {
      symbol: string;
      dimension_id: string;
      label: string;
      detail: string;
      source:
        | "catalog_loading"
        | "browser_preview_model_metadata"
        | "dec018_catalog_accepted"
        | "dec018_catalog_unreviewed"
        | "dec018_catalog_miss";
      unit_id: string | null;
      review_status: UnitCatalogEntry["review_status"] | null;
      canonical: boolean | null;
    };

    function isTauriRuntime(): boolean {
      return typeof window !== "undefined" && "__TAURI_INTERNALS__" in window;
    }

    export async function loadUnitCatalog(): Promise<UnitCatalogRoute> {
      if (!isTauriRuntime()) {
        return {
          route: "unavailable_browser_preview",
          diagnostic:
            "UNIT-CATALOG-DESKTOP-ONLY: the reviewed DEC-018 unit catalog is exposed through the " +
            "desktop (Tauri) backend command get_unit_catalog; browser preview mode does not " +
            "synthesize a fallback catalog."
        };
      }
      const catalog = await invoke<UnitCatalog>("get_unit_catalog");
      return { route: "tauri_unit_catalog", catalog };
    }

    export function acceptedUnits(catalog: UnitCatalog): UnitCatalogEntry[] {
      return catalog.entries.filter((entry) => entry.review_status === "accepted");
    }

    export function unitCatalogEntryForSymbol(
      catalog: UnitCatalog,
      symbol: string,
      dimensionId: string
    ): UnitCatalogEntry | null {
      const normalizedSymbol = normalizeSymbol(symbol);
      const normalizedDimension = normalizeDimension(dimensionId);
      return (
        catalog.entries.find(
          (entry) =>
            entry.symbol === normalizedSymbol &&
            entry.review_status === "accepted" &&
            dimensionMatches(entry.dimension_id, normalizedDimension)
        ) ??
        catalog.entries.find(
          (entry) => entry.symbol === normalizedSymbol && dimensionMatches(entry.dimension_id, normalizedDimension)
        ) ??
        null
      );
    }

    export function unitEntryMatchesDimension(entry: UnitCatalogEntry, dimensionId: string): boolean {
      return dimensionMatches(entry.dimension_id, normalizeDimension(dimensionId));
    }

    export function describeUnitBasis(
      route: UnitCatalogRoute | null,
      symbol: string,
      dimensionId: string
    ): UnitBasisDisplay {
      const normalizedSymbol = normalizeSymbol(symbol);
      const normalizedDimension = normalizeDimension(dimensionId);
      if (!route) {
        return {
          symbol: normalizedSymbol,
          dimension_id: normalizedDimension,
          label: `${normalizedSymbol}, catalog loading`,
          detail: "DEC-018 unit catalog has not finished loading.",
          source: "catalog_loading",
          unit_id: null,
          review_status: null,
          canonical: null
        };
      }
      if (route.route === "unavailable_browser_preview") {
        return {
          symbol: normalizedSymbol,
          dimension_id: normalizedDimension,
          label: `${normalizedSymbol}, model metadata`,
          detail: route.diagnostic,
          source: "browser_preview_model_metadata",
          unit_id: null,
          review_status: null,
          canonical: null
        };
      }

      const entry = unitCatalogEntryForSymbol(route.catalog, normalizedSymbol, normalizedDimension);
      if (!entry) {
        return {
          symbol: normalizedSymbol,
          dimension_id: normalizedDimension,
          label: `${normalizedSymbol}, catalog mismatch`,
          detail: `No DEC-018 catalog entry matches symbol=${normalizedSymbol} and dimension=${normalizedDimension}.`,
          source: "dec018_catalog_miss",
          unit_id: null,
          review_status: null,
          canonical: null
        };
      }

      const accepted = entry.review_status === "accepted";
      const basis = entry.canonical ? "DEC-018 canonical" : "DEC-018 display";
      return {
        symbol: normalizedSymbol,
        dimension_id: normalizedDimension,
        label: `${entry.symbol}, ${accepted ? basis : `DEC-018 ${entry.review_status}`}`,
        detail: `${entry.unit_id}; dimension=${entry.dimension_id}; provenance=${entry.provenance}; ${entry.factor_representation}`,
        source: accepted ? "dec018_catalog_accepted" : "dec018_catalog_unreviewed",
        unit_id: entry.unit_id,
        review_status: entry.review_status,
        canonical: entry.canonical
      };
    }

    function normalizeSymbol(symbol: string): string {
      return symbol.trim() || "TBD";
    }

    function normalizeDimension(dimensionId: string): string {
      return dimensionId.trim() || "TBD";
    }

    function dimensionMatches(entryDimension: string, requestedDimension: string): boolean {
      if (entryDimension === requestedDimension) return true;
      return equivalentDimensions(requestedDimension).includes(entryDimension);
    }

    function equivalentDimensions(dimensionId: string): string[] {
      switch (dimensionId) {
        case "displacement":
          return ["length"];
        case "stress":
          return ["pressure"];
        case "rotation":
          return ["angle"];
        case "slope":
          return ["dimensionless"];
        case "linear_stiffness":
          return ["force_per_length"];
        case "volume_per_length":
          return ["area"];
        default:
          return [];
      }
    }

## Component: apps/desktop/src/services/usePackageHash.ts

    import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
    import type { PackageHashEvidence } from "../types";
    import { computePackageHash } from "./hashService";

    export function usePackageHash(
      packageId: string | null,
      basePacket: unknown,
      payloadExcludes: PackageHashEvidence["payload_excludes"] = "validation_report_package_hash_fields"
    ): PackageHashEvidence | null {
      // Plain JSON text as the effect key: stable for identical packet content
      // across re-renders. Canonicalization and hashing happen inside the wasm
      // engine (H1 / F-5a) — the frontend no longer canonicalizes anything.
      const packetJson = basePacket === undefined || basePacket === null ? null : JSON.stringify(basePacket);
      const [packageHash, setPackageHash] = useState<PackageHashEvidence | null>(null);
      useEffect(() => {
        let active = true;
        setPackageHash(null);
        if (!packetJson || !packageId) return;
        computePackageHash(packageId, JSON.parse(packetJson), payloadExcludes).then((hash) => {
          if (active) setPackageHash(hash);
        });
        return () => {
          active = false;
        };
      }, [packetJson, packageId, payloadExcludes]);
      return packageHash;
    }

    export function withCanonicalPackageHash<T extends { manifest: object; validation_report: object }>(
      packet: T,
      packageHash: PackageHashEvidence | null
    ) {
      return {
        ...packet,
        manifest: {
          ...packet.manifest,
          canonical_package_hash_status: packageHash
            ? "computed_local_preview_sha256"
            : "TBD_browser_preview_does_not_emit_canonical_package_hash",
          canonical_package_hash: packageHash
        },
        validation_report: {
          ...packet.validation_report,
          hash_validation_status: packageHash
            ? "package_hash_computed_local_preview_not_independently_validated"
            : "TBD_browser_preview_does_not_emit_canonical_package_hash"
        }
      };
    }

## Component: apps/desktop/src/services/wasmEngine/loadWasmEngine.ts

    // Loads the wasm32 build of `core/model_operations/operation_applier` — the
    // sole browser-mode operation engine per DEC-020 / ADR-0001. The generated
    // glue and wasm artifact are produced by `npm run build:wasm` into
    // `public/wasm-engine/` (TP-APP-R2-WASMPKG-001: Vite serves `public/` at the
    // site root in dev and copies it verbatim into `dist`, so the one root
    // `/wasm-engine/` URL resolves identically under the dev server, `vite
    // preview` of the production dist, and the packaged tauri:// asset protocol)
    // and are not committed; an absent artifact is an explicit named failure
    // (WASM-ENGINE-ASSET-ABSENT) with the build command in the message — never a
    // silent fallback to another engine, because no other engine exists.

    export const WASM_ENGINE_ABSENT_DIAGNOSTIC = "WASM-ENGINE-ASSET-ABSENT";
    export const WASM_ENGINE_BUILD_COMMAND = "npm run build:wasm --workspace apps/desktop";

    export type WasmOperationEngine = {
      validateOperationJson: (modelJson: string, intentJson: string, claimedModelHashJson: string) => string;
      applyOperationJson: (modelJson: string, intentJson: string, claimedModelHashJson: string) => string;
      // H1 / F-5a hash seam: the engine's canonicalization and hashing, exported
      // so the frontend never re-implements either. Both throw on invalid JSON
      // input (WASM-ENGINE-INPUT-JSON-INVALID).
      canonicalJsonString: (valueJson: string) => string;
      canonicalSha256Hex: (valueJson: string) => string;
    };

    type GeneratedGlueModule = {
      default: (options?: { module_or_path: BufferSource | string | URL }) => Promise<unknown>;
      validate_operation_json: (modelJson: string, intentJson: string, claimedModelHashJson: string) => string;
      apply_operation_json: (modelJson: string, intentJson: string, claimedModelHashJson: string) => string;
      canonical_json_string: (valueJson: string) => string;
      canonical_sha256_hex: (valueJson: string) => string;
    };

    // The browser specifier is intentionally held in a constant (not an inline
    // literal) so neither tsc nor Vite resolves it at build time: the generated
    // module is absent until `npm run build:wasm` runs, and its absence must be
    // a runtime diagnostic, not a compile failure. `public/` contents are served
    // at the site root in every browser lane.
    const GENERATED_GLUE_FILENAME = "open_pipe_stress_operation_applier.js";
    const GENERATED_WASM_FILENAME = "open_pipe_stress_operation_applier_bg.wasm";
    const BROWSER_GLUE_PATH = `/wasm-engine/${GENERATED_GLUE_FILENAME}`;

    // The browser import must be a FULLY-QUALIFIED URL (origin included), not the
    // root-absolute path: Vite's dev transform wraps dynamic imports in its
    // `injectQuery(url, "import")` client helper, and the dev server refuses to
    // serve publicDir files with the `?import` query (HTTP 500). The helper skips
    // URLs that carry a protocol, so resolving against `location.href` makes the
    // browser import the raw asset identically under the dev server, `vite
    // preview`, and the packaged `tauri://localhost/` asset protocol.
    function browserGlueUrl(): string {
      return new URL(BROWSER_GLUE_PATH, globalThis.location.href).href;
    }

    let enginePromise: Promise<WasmOperationEngine> | null = null;

    function absenceError(stage: string, detail: string): Error {
      return new Error(
        `${WASM_ENGINE_ABSENT_DIAGNOSTIC}: ${stage}: ${detail} — the wasm operation engine is required in ` +
          `browser mode (DEC-020 / ADR-0001) and no fallback engine exists. Build it with \`${WASM_ENGINE_BUILD_COMMAND}\`.`
      );
    }

    // Node / Vitest: locate the generated assets on disk. Vite's test transform
    // rewrites `import.meta.url` to a root-relative file URL (`file:///src/...`),
    // so module-relative resolution alone is unreliable; probe the deterministic
    // candidates and fail loudly listing every probed path. This probes locations
    // of ONE artifact set — it is not an engine fallback.
    async function locateAssetsUnderNode(): Promise<{ glueUrl: string; wasmBytes: Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer> }> {
      const fsSpecifier = "node:fs/promises";
      const pathSpecifier = "node:path";
      const urlSpecifier = "node:url";
      const { readFile } = (await import(/* @vite-ignore */ fsSpecifier)) as typeof import("node:fs/promises");
      const path = (await import(/* @vite-ignore */ pathSpecifier)) as typeof import("node:path");
      const { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } = (await import(/* @vite-ignore */ urlSpecifier)) as typeof import("node:url");

      const candidates: string[] = [];
      try {
        // Real ESM: `public/wasm-engine/` relative to this module's directory
        // (`src/services/wasmEngine/`).
        candidates.push(
          path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..", "..", "..", "public", "wasm-engine")
        );
      } catch {
        // import.meta.url is not a parseable file URL under this transform.
      }
      // Vitest with cwd at the desktop workspace, and runs from the repo root.
      candidates.push(path.resolve(process.cwd(), "public", "wasm-engine"));
      candidates.push(path.resolve(process.cwd(), "apps", "desktop", "public", "wasm-engine"));

      for (const candidate of candidates) {
        try {
          // Copy into a fresh Uint8Array: Node's Buffer is typed over
          // ArrayBufferLike, which BufferSource rejects.
          const wasmBytes = new Uint8Array(await readFile(path.join(candidate, GENERATED_WASM_FILENAME)));
          return { glueUrl: pathToFileURL(path.join(candidate, GENERATED_GLUE_FILENAME)).href, wasmBytes };
        } catch {
          // Probe the next candidate; absence is reported below with all paths.
        }
      }
      throw absenceError("wasm artifact not found on disk", `probed: ${candidates.join(", ")}`);
    }

    async function instantiate(): Promise<WasmOperationEngine> {
      const runningUnderNode = typeof process !== "undefined" && Boolean(process.versions?.node);
      let glue: GeneratedGlueModule;

      if (runningUnderNode) {
        const { glueUrl, wasmBytes } = await locateAssetsUnderNode();
        try {
          glue = (await import(/* @vite-ignore */ glueUrl)) as GeneratedGlueModule;
        } catch (error) {
          throw absenceError("generated glue module import failed", String(error));
        }
        try {
          await glue.default({ module_or_path: wasmBytes });
        } catch (error) {
          throw absenceError("wasm instantiation failed", String(error));
        }
      } else {
        try {
          glue = (await import(/* @vite-ignore */ browserGlueUrl())) as GeneratedGlueModule;
        } catch (error) {
          throw absenceError("generated glue module import failed", String(error));
        }
        try {
          // Real browser: the wasm-bindgen web-target default path fetches the
          // sibling _bg.wasm relative to the glue module URL (`import.meta.url`),
          // which is `/wasm-engine/` in every browser lane.
          await glue.default();
        } catch (error) {
          throw absenceError("wasm instantiation failed", String(error));
        }
      }

      return {
        validateOperationJson: glue.validate_operation_json,
        applyOperationJson: glue.apply_operation_json,
        canonicalJsonString: glue.canonical_json_string,
        canonicalSha256Hex: glue.canonical_sha256_hex
      };
    }

    /// Lazy singleton: first caller triggers instantiation; failures are not
    /// cached so a later call after `npm run build:wasm` succeeds.
    export function loadWasmEngine(): Promise<WasmOperationEngine> {
      if (!enginePromise) {
        enginePromise = instantiate().catch((error: unknown) => {
          enginePromise = null;
          throw error;
        });
      }
      return enginePromise;
    }

## Component: apps/desktop/src/styles.css

    /*
     * OpenPipeStress desktop shell stylesheet.
     *
     * Structure (TP-APP-R2-UXSHELL-001):
     *   1. Base + chrome ......... :root, body, .loading-screen, .topbar,
     *      .project-toolbar, .boundary-strip, .app-footer
     *   2. Workspace layout ...... .workspace (column flex filling the shell),
     *      .modeling-workspace (persistent spatial core: model tree | 3D
     *      viewport | property inspector, each in an independently scrolling
     *      .workspace-pane), .workspace-dock (guided workbench rail/current-step
     *      surface, always-visible .workspace-nav section tabs + scrolling
     *      .workspace-dock-body holding one .workspace-dock-section per nav item;
     *      inactive sections are display:none but stay mounted so panel state
     *      survives navigation)
     *   3. Panel primitives ...... .panel, .panel-title, .panel-subtitle
     *   4. Feature panels ........ model tree, inspector/editor intents,
     *      viewport, load-case manager, solve/results/report, exports, audit
     *      panels (one block per feature, in source order below)
     *
     * Layout invariants: every scroll container is a .workspace-pane, the
     * .workspace-dock-body, or an explicitly bounded panel region (e.g. the
     * operation apply queue); panels grow with content instead of clipping it,
     * and form rows wrap (flex-wrap / auto-fit grids) rather than overflow.
     */

    :root {
      color: #1d2424;
      background: #ecefeb;
      font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
      font-synthesis: none;
      text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
    }

    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    body {
      margin: 0;
      min-width: 1120px;
      min-height: 760px;
    }

    button,
    input,
    textarea {
      font: inherit;
    }

    button:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid #f08c22;
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    .loading-screen {
      display: grid;
      min-height: 100vh;
      place-items: center;
      color: #2d3837;
    }

    .app-shell {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-rows: auto auto auto 1fr auto;
      height: 100vh;
      min-height: 760px;
    }

    .topbar {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 24px;
      padding: 14px 18px;
      color: #f8faf7;
      background: #263331;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #182321;
    }

    .topbar h1 {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0;
    }

    .topbar p {
      margin: 4px 0 0;
      color: #c7d0cb;
      font-size: 13px;
    }

    .topbar-actions {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      padding: 6px 9px;
      min-height: 30px;
      border: 1px solid #53635f;
      border-radius: 4px;
      color: #f8faf7;
      background: #33423f;
      font-size: 12px;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .project-toolbar {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 16px;
      min-height: 42px;
      padding: 8px 18px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #c8d0cb;
      background: #f7f9f6;
      color: #2d3837;
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .project-toolbar strong,
    .project-toolbar span {
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .project-toolbar-actions {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .project-toolbar button {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      min-height: 30px;
      padding: 5px 9px;
      border: 1px solid #b8c3bd;
      border-radius: 4px;
      color: #263331;
      background: #ffffff;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .project-toolbar button:disabled {
      color: #7b8580;
      cursor: not-allowed;
    }

    .boundary-strip {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 8px;
      min-height: 38px;
      padding: 7px 18px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #c8d0cb;
      background: #edf2ef;
    }

    .boundary-item {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 18px auto minmax(0, 1fr);
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      min-width: 0;
      color: #2d3837;
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .boundary-item strong {
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .boundary-item code {
      min-width: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      color: #4d5a56;
      font-family: inherit;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    /* === 2. Workspace layout (TP-APP-R2-UXSHELL-001) === */

    .workspace {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
      min-height: 0;
      padding: 10px;
    }

    /* Persistent spatial core (PRD 14.1): model tree | viewport | inspector. */
    .modeling-workspace {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 280px minmax(420px, 1fr) 380px;
      gap: 10px;
      flex: 1 1 0;
      min-height: 240px;
    }

    /* Each core column scrolls independently; panels inside grow with content. */
    .workspace-pane {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
      min-height: 0;
      min-width: 0;
      overflow-y: auto;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    .workspace-pane > .panel,
    .workspace-pane > .viewport-shell {
      flex: 0 0 auto;
    }

    /* Section dock: always-visible navigation + one scrolling section at a time. */
    .workspace-dock {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
      flex: 1.15 1 0;
      min-height: 260px;
    }

    .guided-workbench {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(360px, 1fr) minmax(280px, 0.8fr) minmax(360px, 1.05fr);
      align-items: start;
      gap: 10px;
      min-height: 96px;
      padding: 8px 10px;
      border: 1px solid #c3ccc6;
      border-radius: 6px;
      background: #f8faf7;
    }

    .journey-rail {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 7px;
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .journey-step {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 18px minmax(0, 1fr);
      grid-template-rows: auto auto;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 2px 7px;
      min-width: 0;
      min-height: 40px;
      padding: 6px 8px;
      border: 1px solid #c7d0cb;
      border-radius: 5px;
      color: #25312f;
      background: #ffffff;
      cursor: pointer;
      text-align: left;
    }

    .journey-step.active {
      border-color: #2d5b50;
      background: #e4f0eb;
      box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 #2d5b50;
    }

    .journey-step > svg {
      grid-row: 1 / 3;
      color: #4d5a56;
    }

    .journey-step span,
    .journey-step small {
      min-width: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .journey-step span {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .journey-step small {
      color: #66736f;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 650;
    }

    .current-step-panel {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
      gap: 8px;
      min-width: 0;
      padding: 8px 10px;
      border: 1px solid #d7ded9;
      border-radius: 5px;
      background: #ffffff;
    }

    .current-step-kicker {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 2px;
      color: #68736f;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .current-step-panel h2 {
      margin: 0;
      color: #1f2c29;
      font-size: 15px;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .current-step-panel p {
      margin: 4px 0 0;
      color: #475451;
      font-size: 12px;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .current-step-facts {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.75fr) minmax(0, 1.25fr);
      gap: 7px;
    }

    .current-step-facts span {
      min-width: 0;
      padding: 5px 7px;
      border: 1px solid #e1e6e3;
      border-radius: 4px;
      background: #f8faf8;
      color: #52605b;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 650;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .guided-journey-stack {
      display: grid;
      gap: 5px;
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .guided-journey-tabs {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .guided-journey-tab {
      min-width: 0;
      min-height: 24px;
      padding: 4px 6px;
      border: 1px solid #c7d0cb;
      border-radius: 4px;
      color: #31403d;
      background: #ffffff;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 800;
      overflow: hidden;

    }

    .guided-journey-tab.active {
      border-color: #2d5b50;

    }

    .a12-authoring-journey,
    .r3-guided-flow {
      display: grid;

    .a12-journey-header,

      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .workspace-journey-item code {
      color: #586460;
      font-family: inherit;
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .workspace-dock-body {
      flex: 1 1 0;
      min-height: 0;
      overflow-y: auto;
    }

    .workspace-dock-section {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(380px, 1fr));
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: start;
    }

    .workspace-dock-section > .panel {
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .workspace-dock-section > .review-apply-drawer {
      min-width: 0;
    }

    /* Inactive sections stay mounted (state survives navigation) but are fully
       hidden, including from the accessibility tree. */
    .workspace-dock-section.inactive {
      display: none;
    }

    /* === 3. Panel primitives === */

    .panel,
    .viewport-shell {
      min-height: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid #c8d0cb;
      border-radius: 6px;
      background: #fbfcfa;
      box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(27 39 37 / 8%);
    }

    .panel {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      padding: 12px;
    }

    .panel-title {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 7px;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      color: #465450;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .model-tree {
      overflow: auto;
    }

    /* Two-row layout: filter input + clear button on top, match summary below.
       The single-row layout overlapped at the narrow tree-column width. */
    .model-tree-controls {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 32px;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px 8px;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }

    .model-tree-controls > span {
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
    }

    .model-tree-controls label {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 16px auto minmax(0, 1fr);
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .model-tree-controls label span,
    .model-tree-controls > span {
      color: #65716c;
      font-size: 11px;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .model-tree-controls input {
      min-width: 0;
      min-height: 30px;
      padding: 5px 8px;
      border: 1px solid #c8d0cb;
      border-radius: 4px;
      color: #25312f;
      background: #ffffff;
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .model-tree-controls button {
      grid-row: 1;
      grid-column: 2;
      display: inline-grid;
      width: 32px;
      height: 30px;
      place-items: center;
      border: 1px solid #c8d0cb;
      border-radius: 4px;
      color: #25312f;
      background: #ffffff;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .model-tree-controls button:disabled {
      color: #9aa39f;
      cursor: not-allowed;
    }

    .tree-group h3 {
      margin: 14px 0 6px;
      color: #6b736f;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .tree-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 20px minmax(0, 1fr);
      align-items: start;
      gap: 7px;
      width: 100%;
      min-height: 42px;
      padding: 7px;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 4px;
      color: #263331;
      background: transparent;
      text-align: left;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .tree-row.active {
      background: #dce8e2;
    }

    .tree-row strong,
    .tree-row small {
      display: block;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .tree-row strong {
      font-size: 13px;
    }

    .tree-row small {
      margin-top: 2px;
      color: #68746f;
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .inspector h2,
    .agent-panel h2 {
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      font-size: 15px;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .inspector dl {
      display: grid;
      gap: 8px;
      margin: 0;
      overflow: auto;
    }

    .inspector dl div {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 100px minmax(0, 1fr);
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .inspector dt {
      color: #69736f;
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .inspector dd {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 12px;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .inspector {
      overflow: auto;
    }

    .editor-intent {
      display: grid;
      gap: 9px;
      margin-top: 14px;
      padding-top: 12px;
      border-top: 1px solid #d8dfdb;
    }

    .editor-intent h3 {
      margin: 0;
      color: #465450;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .editor-intent-controls {
      display: grid;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .editor-intent-controls label {
      display: grid;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .editor-intent-controls label span {
      color: #65716c;
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .editor-intent-controls input,
    .editor-intent-controls select {
      min-width: 0;
      min-height: 30px;
      padding: 5px 8px;
      border: 1px solid #c8d0cb;
      border-radius: 4px;
      color: #25312f;
      background: #ffffff;
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .editor-intent-checkbox-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .editor-intent-checkbox-grid label {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      min-height: 28px;
      padding: 4px 6px;
      border: 1px solid #d3d9d5;
      border-radius: 4px;
      background: #ffffff;
      color: #34413e;
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .editor-intent-checkbox-grid input {
      min-width: auto;
      min-height: auto;
      padding: 0;
    }

    .editor-intent-controls button {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 6px;
      min-height: 30px;
      padding: 5px 9px;
      border: 1px solid #b8c3bd;
      border-radius: 4px;
      color: #263331;
      background: #ffffff;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .editor-intent-controls button:disabled {
      color: #9aa39f;
      cursor: not-allowed;
    }

    .editor-intent-preview,
    .editor-intent-queue article {
      padding: 8px;
      border: 1px solid #d9dfdb;
      border-radius: 4px;
      background: #ffffff;
    }

    .editor-intent-meta,
    .editor-intent-queue {
      display: grid;
      gap: 7px;
    }

    .editor-intent-fact {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 92px minmax(0, 1fr);
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 5px 6px;
      border: 1px solid #e1e6e3;
      border-radius: 4px;
      background: #f8faf8;
    }

    .editor-intent-fact span,
    .editor-intent-queue small,
    .editor-intent-queue span {
      color: #65716c;
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .editor-intent-fact strong,
    .editor-intent-queue strong {
      color: #25312f;
      font-size: 12px;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .editor-intent-queue article {
      display: grid;
      gap: 3px;
    }

    .editor-inline-validation {
      display: grid;
      gap: 4px;
      min-height: 28px;
      padding: 7px;
      border: 1px solid #d9dfdb;
      border-radius: 4px;
      background: #ffffff;
      color: #2d3837;
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .editor-inline-validation strong,
    .editor-inline-validation small {
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .editor-inline-validation small {
      color: #5f6c68;
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .viewport-shell {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-rows: auto auto auto;
    }

    .viewport-frame {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      height: clamp(240px, 25vw, 325px);
      min-height: 240px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .viewport-toolbar {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: start;
      gap: 12px;
      min-height: 36px;
      padding: 9px 12px;
      color: #31403d;
      background: #edf2ef;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #c8d0cb;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .viewport-canvas {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      cursor: crosshair;
    }

    .viewport-canvas canvas {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
    }

    .viewport-fallback {
      display: grid;
      height: 100%;
      min-height: 320px;
      place-items: center;
      padding: 24px;
      color: #44504c;
      background: #f4f6f4;
      font-size: 13px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .viewport-selection-layer {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .viewport-toolbar > span {
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .viewport-deformation-status {
      display: grid;
      flex: 1 1 auto;
      gap: 2px;
      max-width: 58%;
      padding-left: 10px;
      border-left: 3px solid #8a9691;
      color: #31403d;
    }

    .viewport-deformation-status strong,
    .viewport-deformation-status small {
      min-width: 0;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .viewport-deformation-status small {
      color: #66736f;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .viewport-deformation-status.available {
      border-left: 3px solid #0f8f85;
    }

    .viewport-deformation-status.blocked {
      border-left: 3px solid #b54708;
    }

    .viewport-select-target {
      position: absolute;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 4px;
      width: 58px;
      height: 26px;
      padding: 0 5px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(46, 68, 62, 0.48);
      border-radius: 4px;
      color: #22312e;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
      box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(35, 45, 42, 0.14);
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1;
      pointer-events: auto;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    }

    .viewport-select-target span {
      min-width: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .viewport-select-target.node {
      border-color: rgba(47, 111, 115, 0.6);
    }

    .viewport-select-target.pipe {
      border-color: rgba(79, 111, 115, 0.62);
    }

    .viewport-select-target.support {
      border-color: rgba(107, 125, 73, 0.62);
    }

    .viewport-select-target.component {
      border-color: rgba(135, 76, 98, 0.62);
    }

    .viewport-select-target.active,
    .viewport-select-target:focus-visible {
      color: #141f1d;
      background: #fff4df;
      border-color: #d57d16;
      outline: 2px solid rgba(213, 125, 22, 0.35);
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    .viewport-intents {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 10px 12px;
      border-top: 1px solid #c8d0cb;
      background: #fbfcfa;
    }

    .viewport-intent-controls,
    .viewport-intent-actions {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-content: start;
      gap: 7px;
    }

    .viewport-node-form,
    .viewport-pipe-form {
      display: grid;
      gap: 7px;
      width: 100%;
    }

    .viewport-node-form {
      grid-template-columns: minmax(96px, 1.2fr) minmax(96px, 1.2fr) repeat(3, minmax(52px, 0.7fr)) auto;
    }

    .viewport-pipe-form {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(86px, 1fr));
    }

    .viewport-node-form label,
    .viewport-pipe-form label,
    .viewport-endpoint-field {
      display: grid;
      gap: 3px;
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .viewport-node-form span,
    .viewport-pipe-form span {
      color: #54615d;
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .viewport-node-form input,
    .viewport-pipe-form input,
    .viewport-pipe-form select {
      width: 100%;
      min-width: 0;
      height: 30px;
      padding: 5px 7px;
      border: 1px solid #b8c3bd;
      border-radius: 4px;
      color: #263331;
      background: #ffffff;
    }

    .viewport-field-heading {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 6px;
      min-width: 0;
      min-height: 18px;
    }

    .viewport-pipe-form .viewport-endpoint-pick {
      align-self: center;
      min-height: 20px;
      padding: 1px 6px;
      font-size: 10px;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .viewport-pipe-form .viewport-endpoint-pick[aria-pressed="true"] {
      color: #141f1d;
      background: #fff4df;
      border-color: #d57d16;
    }

    .viewport-intent-actions button,
    .viewport-node-form button,
    .viewport-pipe-form button {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 6px;
      min-height: 30px;
      padding: 5px 9px;
      border: 1px solid #b8c3bd;
      border-radius: 4px;
      color: #263331;
      background: #ffffff;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .viewport-node-form button,
    .viewport-pipe-form button {
      align-self: end;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .viewport-node-form button:disabled,
    .viewport-pipe-form button:disabled {
      color: #7d8985;
      background: #eef2ef;
      cursor: not-allowed;
    }

    .viewport-intent-list {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 7px;
      min-height: 30px;
    }

    .viewport-intent-list p {
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
      margin: 0;
      color: #55625e;
      font-size: 12px;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .viewport-intent-list article {
      display: grid;
      gap: 2px;
      padding: 7px;
      border: 1px solid #d9dfdb;
      border-radius: 4px;
      background: #ffffff;
      color: #2d3837;
    }

    .viewport-intent-list strong,
    .viewport-intent-list span,
    .viewport-intent-list small {
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .viewport-intent-list strong {
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .viewport-intent-list span,
    .viewport-intent-list small {
      color: #5f6c68;
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 1040px) {
      .viewport-intents,
      .viewport-node-form,
      .viewport-pipe-form {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }

    @media (max-height: 840px) {
      .workspace {
        gap: 8px;
        padding: 8px 10px;
      }

      .modeling-workspace {
        flex: 0 1 210px;
        min-height: 210px;
      }

      .workspace-dock {
        flex: 1 1 0;
        min-height: 300px;
      }
    }

    .record-list,
    .diagnostic-list,
    .proposal-body,
    .operation-record-list,
    .report-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 9px;
      overflow: auto;
    }

    .report-actions {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 9px;
    }

    .report-export-link {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      min-height: 30px;
      padding: 5px 9px;
      border: 1px solid #b8c3bd;
      border-radius: 4px;
      color: #263331;
      background: #ffffff;
      font-size: 12px;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    .report-actions span {
      min-width: 0;
      color: #56635f;
      font-size: 11px;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .record-row,
    .diagnostic,
    .diff-list article,
    .proposal-section,
    .operation-record,
    .result-detail-panel,
    .diagnostic-detail-panel,
    .mechanics-gap-ledger,
    .gap-list article {
      padding: 9px;
      border: 1px solid #d9dfdb;
      border-radius: 4px;
      background: #ffffff;
    }

    .diagnostic {
      width: 100%;
      color: inherit;
      text-align: left;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .record-row strong,
    .diagnostic strong,
    .operation-record strong,
    .diff-list strong {
      display: block;
      font-size: 13px;
    }

    .record-row small,
    .operation-record small {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 2px;
      color: #6b756f;
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .record-row p,
    .diagnostic p,
    .proposal-body p,
    .operation-record p,
    .diff-list p {
      margin: 6px 0 0;
      color: #3a4643;
      font-size: 12px;
      line-height: 1.35;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .proposal-section {
      display: grid;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .solve-panel {
      min-height: 285px;
    }

    .rule-check-panel {
      min-height: 350px;
    }

    .run-audit-panel {
      min-height: 210px;
    }

    .comparison-panel {
      min-height: 500px;
    }

    .handoff-panel {
      min-height: 330px;
    }

    .results-panel {
      min-height: 520px;
    }

    .agent-panel {
      min-height: 300px;
    }

    .project-storage-panel {
      min-height: 260px;
    }

    .project-validation-panel {
      min-height: 310px;
    }

    .diff-preview-panel {
      min-height: 300px;
    }

    .operation-ledger-panel {
      min-height: 300px;
    }

    .export-review-panel {
      min-height: 320px;
    }

    .native-package-panel {
      min-height: 320px;
    }

    .load-case-manager-panel {
      min-height: 430px;
    }

    .report-panel {
      min-height: 360px;
    }

    .load-case-list,
    .load-primitive-list,
    .load-combination-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }

    .load-case-row,
    .primitive-load-row,
    .combination-summary-row {
      display: grid;
      gap: 3px;
      width: 100%;
      padding: 8px;
      border: 1px solid #d9dfdb;
      border-radius: 4px;
      color: #263331;
      background: #ffffff;
      text-align: left;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .load-case-row.active,
    .primitive-load-row.active,
    .combination-summary-row.active {
      border-color: #86aaa0;
      background: #eef7f2;
      outline: 2px solid rgba(76, 127, 109, 0.18);
      outline-offset: -2px;
    }

    .load-combination-row {
      display: grid;
      gap: 3px;
      padding: 8px;
      border: 1px solid #d9dfdb;
      border-radius: 4px;
      background: #ffffff;
    }

    .load-case-row strong,
    .primitive-load-row strong,
    .load-combination-row strong,
    .combination-summary-row strong {
      font-size: 12px;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .load-case-row small,
    .primitive-load-row small,
    .load-combination-row small,
    .combination-summary-row small {
      color: #66736f;
      font-size: 11px;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .combination-term-list {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px, 1fr));
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .combination-term-row {
      min-height: 28px;
      padding: 5px 7px;
      border: 1px solid #d9dfdb;
      border-radius: 4px;
      color: #263331;
      background: #ffffff;
      font-size: 11px;
      text-align: left;
      cursor: pointer;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .combination-term-row.active {
      border-color: #86aaa0;
      background: #eef7f2;
      outline: 2px solid rgba(76, 127, 109, 0.18);
      outline-offset: -2px;
    }

    .load-magnitude-editor,
    .load-metadata-editor,
    .combination-basis-editor,
    .combination-factor-editor,
    .combination-term-create-editor,
    .load-case-create-editor,
    .primitive-load-create-editor {
      display: grid;
      gap: 8px;
      margin: 2px 0 10px;
      padding: 9px;
      border: 1px solid #d8dfdb;
      border-radius: 4px;
      background: #f8faf8;
    }

    .load-editor-heading {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 16px minmax(0, 0.7fr) minmax(0, 1.3fr);
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .load-editor-heading strong,
    .load-editor-heading span,
    .load-edit-preview {
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .load-editor-heading strong {
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .load-editor-heading span {
      color: #66736f;
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .load-editor-controls,
    .load-metadata-controls,
    .combination-basis-controls,
    .combination-factor-controls,
    .combination-delete-controls,
    .load-case-delete-controls,
    .combination-create-controls,
    .combination-term-create-controls,
    .load-case-create-controls,
    .primitive-load-create-controls {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(72px, 0.7fr) minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
      align-items: end;
      gap: 7px;
    }

    .load-metadata-controls {
      grid-template-columns: minmax(72px, 0.7fr) minmax(92px, 0.8fr) minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    }

    .load-case-create-controls {
      grid-template-columns: minmax(92px, 0.8fr) minmax(120px, 1fr) minmax(110px, 0.8fr) minmax(86px, 0.7fr) minmax(0, 1.1fr) auto;
    }

    .combination-term-create-controls {
      grid-template-columns: minmax(126px, 1fr) minmax(98px, 0.8fr) minmax(80px, 0.6fr) minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    }

    .combination-create-controls {
      grid-template-columns: minmax(118px, 0.9fr) minmax(130px, 1fr) minmax(92px, 0.7fr) minmax(104px, 0.8fr) minmax(74px, 0.5fr) minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    }

    .combination-delete-controls,
    .load-case-delete-controls {
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    }

    .primitive-load-create-controls {
      grid-template-columns: minmax(94px, 0.8fr) minmax(122px, 1fr) minmax(98px, 0.8fr) minmax(86px, 0.7fr) minmax(86px, 0.7fr) minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    }

    .load-editor-controls label,
    .load-metadata-controls label,
    .combination-basis-controls label,
    .combination-factor-controls label,
    .combination-delete-controls label,
    .load-case-delete-controls label,
    .combination-create-controls label,
    .combination-term-create-controls label,
    .load-case-create-controls label,
    .primitive-load-create-controls label {
      display: grid;
      gap: 3px;
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .load-editor-controls span,
    .load-metadata-controls span,
    .combination-basis-controls span,
    .combination-factor-controls span,
    .combination-delete-controls span,
    .load-case-delete-controls span,
    .combination-create-controls span,
    .combination-term-create-controls span,
    .load-case-create-controls span,
    .primitive-load-create-controls span {
      color: #54615d;
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .load-editor-controls input,
    .load-metadata-controls input,
    .load-metadata-controls select,
    .combination-basis-controls input,
    .combination-factor-controls input,
    .combination-delete-controls input,
    .load-case-delete-controls input,
    .combination-create-controls input,
    .combination-create-controls select,
    .combination-term-create-controls input,
    .combination-term-create-controls select,
    .load-case-create-controls input,
    .primitive-load-create-controls input,
    .primitive-load-create-controls select {
      min-width: 0;
      height: 30px;
      padding: 5px 7px;
      border: 1px solid #b8c3bd;
      border-radius: 4px;
      color: #263331;
      background: #ffffff;
    }

    .load-editor-controls button,
    .load-metadata-controls button,
    .combination-basis-controls button,
    .combination-factor-controls button,
    .combination-delete-controls button,
    .load-case-delete-controls button,
    .combination-create-controls button,
    .combination-term-create-controls button,
    .load-case-create-controls button,
    .primitive-load-create-controls button {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 6px;
      min-height: 30px;
      padding: 5px 9px;
      border: 1px solid #b8c3bd;
      border-radius: 4px;
      color: #263331;
      background: #ffffff;
      cursor: pointer;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .load-editor-controls button:disabled,
    .load-metadata-controls button:disabled,
    .combination-basis-controls button:disabled,
    .combination-factor-controls button:disabled,
    .combination-delete-controls button:disabled,
    .load-case-delete-controls button:disabled,
    .combination-create-controls button:disabled,
    .combination-term-create-controls button:disabled,
    .load-case-create-controls button:disabled,
    .primitive-load-create-controls button:disabled {
      color: #7d8985;
      background: #eef2ef;
      cursor: not-allowed;
    }

    .comparison-summary {
      display: grid;
      gap: 6px;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .comparison-fact {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 82px minmax(0, 1fr);
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 5px 6px;
      border: 1px solid #e1e6e3;
      border-radius: 4px;
      background: #f8faf8;
    }

    .comparison-fact span {
      color: #65716c;
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .comparison-fact strong {
      color: #25312f;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 650;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .comparison-table {
      display: grid;
      flex: 1 1 auto;
      min-height: 0;
      overflow: auto;
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .comparison-delta-header,
    .comparison-delta-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(145px, 1.5fr) minmax(72px, 0.75fr) minmax(96px, 0.9fr) minmax(70px, 0.6fr);
      gap: 6px;
      width: 100%;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #e1e6e3;
      text-align: left;
    }

    .comparison-delta-header {
      padding: 5px;
      color: #65716c;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .comparison-delta-shell {
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .comparison-delta-row {
      align-items: start;
      padding: 5px;
      border: 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #e1e6e3;
      color: #25312f;
      background: transparent;
      font: inherit;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .comparison-delta-row:hover,
    .comparison-delta-row:focus-visible {
      background: #eef5f2;
      outline: 2px solid #4c7f6d;
      outline-offset: -2px;
    }

    .comparison-delta-row span {
      min-width: 0;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .comparison-delta-row span:first-child {
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .comparison-delta-row small {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 3px;
      color: #65716c;
      font-weight: 400;
    }

    .proposal-section h3 {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      margin: 0;
      color: #465450;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .proposal-meta-grid,
    .proposal-flag-grid {
      display: grid;
      gap: 7px;
    }

    .proposal-fact,
    .proposal-flag {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 116px minmax(0, 1fr);
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 6px;
      border: 1px solid #e1e6e3;
      border-radius: 4px;
      background: #f8faf8;
    }

    .proposal-fact span,
    .proposal-flag span {
      color: #65716c;
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .proposal-fact strong,
    .proposal-flag strong {
      color: #25312f;
      font-size: 12px;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .proposal-flag.false strong {
      color: #2d5b50;
    }

    .record-row span {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 7px;
      color: #56635f;
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .diagnostic.warning {
      border-color: #e4c478;
      background: #fff8e7;
    }

    .diagnostic.error,
    .diagnostic.blocking {
      border-color: #d7a7a7;
      background: #fff1f1;
    }

    .diagnostic.info {
      border-color: #adc9d9;
      background: #eef7fb;
    }

    .diagnostic.active {
      outline: 2px solid #2d5b50;
      outline-offset: -2px;
    }

    .status-grid {
      display: grid;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .readiness-summary {
      display: grid;
      gap: 7px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .readiness-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 18px 112px minmax(0, 1fr);
      align-items: center;
      gap: 7px;
      min-height: 34px;
      padding: 7px;
      border: 1px solid #d8dfdb;
      border-radius: 4px;
      background: #f7f9f6;
    }

    .readiness-row span {
      color: #65716c;
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .readiness-row strong {
      color: #25312f;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 650;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .readiness-row.ok {
      border-color: #bfd5c8;
      background: #eef7f0;
    }

    .readiness-row.warning {
      border-color: #e4c478;
      background: #fff8e7;
    }

    .readiness-row.blocking {
      border-color: #d7a7a7;
      background: #fff1f1;
    }

    .status-pill {
      display: grid;
      gap: 3px;
      padding: 8px;
      border: 1px solid #d8dfdb;
      border-radius: 4px;
      background: #f7f9f6;
    }

    .status-pill span {
      color: #65716c;
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .status-pill strong {
      color: #25312f;
      font-size: 12px;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .diagnostic-controls {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto 32px;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }

    .diagnostic-controls label {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 16px auto minmax(0, 1fr);
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .diagnostic-controls label span,
    .diagnostic-controls > span {
      color: #65716c;
      font-size: 11px;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .diagnostic-controls input {
      min-width: 0;
      min-height: 30px;
      padding: 5px 8px;
      border: 1px solid #c8d0cb;
      border-radius: 4px;
      color: #25312f;
      background: #ffffff;
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .diagnostic-controls button {
      display: inline-grid;
      width: 32px;
      height: 30px;
      place-items: center;
      border: 1px solid #c8d0cb;
      border-radius: 4px;
      color: #25312f;
      background: #ffffff;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .diagnostic-controls button:disabled {
      color: #9aa39f;
      cursor: not-allowed;
    }

    .diagnostic-severity-summary {
      display: grid;
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .diagnostic-severity-summary span {
      min-width: 0;
      padding: 5px 6px;
      border: 1px solid #d8dfdb;
      border-radius: 4px;
      color: #65716c;
      background: #f7f9f6;
      font-size: 11px;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .diagnostic-severity-summary strong {
      color: #25312f;
    }

    .result-groups {
      display: grid;
      gap: 10px;
      overflow: auto;
    }

    .result-controls {
      display: grid;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }

    .result-family-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(92px, 1fr));
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .result-family-row button {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 6px;
      min-width: 0;
      min-height: 32px;
      padding: 5px 8px;
      border: 1px solid #c8d0cb;
      border-radius: 4px;
      color: #25312f;
      background: #ffffff;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .result-family-row button span {
      overflow: hidden;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .result-family-row button strong {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }

    .result-family-row button.result-family-active {
      border-color: #2d5b50;
      color: #ffffff;
      background: #2d5b50;
    }

    .result-filter-row,
    .result-page-row {
      display: grid;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .result-filter-row {
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto 32px;
    }

    .result-page-row {
      grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    }

    .result-filter-row label {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 16px auto minmax(0, 1fr);
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .result-page-size {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .result-filter-row label span,
    .result-filter-row > span,
    .result-page-size span,
    .result-page-row > span {
      color: #65716c;
      font-size: 11px;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .result-controls input,
    .result-controls select {
      min-width: 0;
      min-height: 30px;
      padding: 5px 8px;
      border: 1px solid #c8d0cb;
      border-radius: 4px;
      color: #25312f;
      background: #ffffff;
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .result-filter-row button {
      display: inline-grid;
      width: 32px;
      height: 30px;
      place-items: center;
      border: 1px solid #c8d0cb;
      border-radius: 4px;
      color: #25312f;
      background: #ffffff;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .result-page-actions {
      display: inline-flex;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .result-page-actions button {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      min-height: 30px;
      padding: 5px 8px;
      border: 1px solid #c8d0cb;
      border-radius: 4px;
      color: #25312f;
      background: #ffffff;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .result-controls button:disabled {
      color: #9aa39f;
      cursor: not-allowed;
    }

    .result-group {
      display: grid;
      gap: 5px;
    }

    .result-group h3 {
      margin: 0;
      color: #465450;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .result-group tbody tr {
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .selected-result-row {
      background: #e8f1ed;
      box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 #2d5b50;
    }

    .result-detail-panel,
    .diagnostic-detail-panel,
    .mechanics-gap-ledger {
      display: grid;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .result-detail-panel h3,
    .diagnostic-detail-panel h3,
    .mechanics-gap-ledger h3 {
      margin: 0;
      color: #465450;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .result-detail-panel dl,
    .diagnostic-detail-panel dl {
      display: grid;
      gap: 6px;
      margin: 0;
    }

    .result-detail-panel dl div,
    .diagnostic-detail-panel dl div {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 116px minmax(0, 1fr);
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .result-detail-panel dt,
    .diagnostic-detail-panel dt,
    .gap-list small {
      color: #65716c;
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .result-detail-panel dd,
    .diagnostic-detail-panel dd {
      margin: 0;
      color: #25312f;
      font-size: 12px;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .endpoint-pair {
      display: grid;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .endpoint-pair h4 {
      margin: 0;
      color: #465450;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .gap-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 7px;
    }

    .gap-list strong {
      display: block;
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .gap-list small {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 2px;
    }

    .gap-list p {
      margin: 5px 0 0;
      color: #3a4643;
      font-size: 12px;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .primary-action,
    .secondary-action,
    .review-action {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 7px;
      min-height: 36px;
      width: 100%;
      border: 1px solid #22302d;
      border-radius: 4px;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .primary-action {
      color: #ffffff;
      background: #2d5b50;
    }

    .secondary-action {
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      color: #24322f;
      background: #e6eee9;
    }

    .review-action {
      color: #63706b;
      background: #eef1ef;
      border-color: #cbd3ce;
      cursor: not-allowed;
    }

    table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    th,
    td {
      padding: 8px 6px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #dfe4e1;
      text-align: left;
      vertical-align: top;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    th {
      color: #59645f;
      font-size: 11px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .muted {
      margin: 0;
      color: #68736f;
      font-size: 12px;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    .diff-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .diff-list small {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 2px;
      color: #66716d;
    }

    .report-line {
      display: grid;
      gap: 3px;
      padding: 8px;
      border: 1px solid #d9dfdb;
      border-radius: 4px;
      background: #ffffff;
    }

    .report-line span {
      color: #65716c;
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .report-line strong {
      color: #25312f;
      font-size: 12px;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .report-note {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 10px;
      color: #65716c;
      font-size: 11px;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .app-footer {
      min-height: 34px;
      padding: 9px 18px;
      color: #3f4a46;
      background: #e0e5e1;
      border-top: 1px solid #c7d0cb;
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 1320px) {
      body {
        min-width: 960px;
      }

      .modeling-workspace {
        grid-template-columns: 250px minmax(400px, 1fr) 340px;
        min-height: 230px;
      }

      .workspace {
        gap: 8px;
        padding: 8px;
      }

      .workspace-dock {
        min-height: 280px;
      }

      .workspace-dock-section {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(340px, 1fr));
      }

    	  .workspace-nav-item {
    	    min-height: 30px;
    	    padding: 4px 9px;
    	    font-size: 12px;
    	  }

    	  .journey-rail {
    	    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
    	  }
    }

    .operation-apply-panel .muted {
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    /* The apply queue can grow long during authoring; bound it and let the queue
       scroll inside the panel instead of pushing the section off screen. */
    .operation-apply-panel {
      min-height: 230px;
      max-height: 560px;
      overflow: auto;
    }

    .operation-apply-panel .operation-record-list {
      overflow: visible;
    }

    .operation-history-actions,
    .operation-apply-actions {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .operation-history-actions {
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .operation-history-actions small {
      color: #64716c;
      font-size: 11px;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .operation-apply-actions {
      margin-top: 6px;
    }

    .operation-history-actions button,
    .operation-apply-actions button {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 6px;
      min-height: 30px;
      padding: 5px 9px;
      border: 1px solid #b8c3bd;
      border-radius: 4px;
      color: #263331;
      background: #ffffff;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .operation-history-actions button:disabled,
    .operation-apply-actions button:disabled {
      color: #8a948f;
      cursor: not-allowed;
    }

    .operation-outcome {
      display: grid;
      gap: 3px;
      margin-top: 6px;
      padding-top: 6px;
      border-top: 1px dashed #d9dfdb;
    }

    .review-apply-drawer {
      display: grid;
      gap: 0;
      min-height: 0;
      padding: 10px;
      border: 1px solid #c8d0cb;
      border-radius: 6px;
      background: #f8faf8;
    }

    .review-apply-drawer-header {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .review-apply-drawer-header span {
      color: #68736f;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .review-apply-drawer-header h2 {
      margin: 1px 0 3px;
      color: #263331;
      font-size: 14px;
    }

    .review-apply-drawer-header p {
      margin: 0;
      color: #5f6b67;
      font-size: 12px;
      line-height: 1.35;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .review-apply-drawer-header button {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 30px;
      padding: 5px 9px;
      border: 1px solid #b8c3bd;
      border-radius: 4px;
      color: #263331;
      background: #ffffff;
      cursor: pointer;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .review-apply-detail-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(340px, 1fr));
      gap: 10px;
      max-height: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .review-apply-drawer.open .review-apply-detail-grid {
      max-height: none;
      margin-top: 10px;
      overflow: visible;
      opacity: 1;
      pointer-events: auto;
    }

    .panel-subtitle {
      margin-top: 10px;
      color: #59645f;
      font-size: 11px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    /* Rule-pack structured AST expression composer (TP-C2-COMPOSER-001). */
    .rule-pack-expression-composer {
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .rule-pack-variable-browser {
      padding: 4px 0;
      color: #59645f;
    }

    .rule-pack-expression-rendering {
      display: grid;
      gap: 4px;
      padding: 6px 8px;
      border: 1px solid #d9dfdb;
      border-radius: 6px;
      background: #f8faf8;
      color: #304139;
    }

    .rule-pack-expression-rendering > small {
      color: #59645f;
    }

    .rule-pack-expression-rendering > pre {
      margin: 0;
      white-space: pre-wrap;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .rule-pack-node {
      display: grid;
      gap: 4px;
      border-left: 2px solid #d9dfdb;
    }

    .rule-pack-node-label {
      color: #59645f;
    }

    .rule-pack-node-readonly {
      color: #8a5a2b;
    }

    .rule-pack-node-field {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .rule-pack-node-field > span {
      min-width: 72px;
      color: #59645f;
    }

    .rule-pack-operand {
      display: grid;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .rule-pack-table-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .rule-pack-check-statuses {
      display: grid;
      gap: 2px;
    }

    import "@testing-library/jest-dom/vitest";

    // Pre-warm the wasm operation engine (DEC-020 / ADR-0001) so jsdom suites
    // that exercise the edit loop start with the engine ready. An absent
    // artifact fails the suite loudly here with the exact build command
    // (WASM-ENGINE-ASSET-ABSENT → `npm run build:wasm --workspace apps/desktop`);
    // no fallback engine exists.
    import { loadWasmEngine } from "../services/wasmEngine/loadWasmEngine";

    await loadWasmEngine();

## Component: apps/desktop/vite.config.ts

    import react from "@vitejs/plugin-react";
    import { existsSync } from "node:fs";
    import path from "node:path";
    import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
    import { defineConfig, type Plugin, type UserConfig } from "vite";

    const desktopRoot = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));

    // TP-APP-R2-WASMPKG-001 build-time guard: the wasm operation engine is the
    // sole browser-mode engine (DEC-020 / ADR-0001), so a production bundle
    // without `public/wasm-engine/` assets is broken by construction — the
    // packaged tauri:// asset protocol 404s onto index.html and the runtime dies
    // with WASM-ENGINE-ASSET-ABSENT on first use. Fail the BUILD loudly instead
    // of shipping that.
    const WASM_ENGINE_ASSET_FILENAMES = [
      "open_pipe_stress_operation_applier.js",
      "open_pipe_stress_operation_applier_bg.wasm"
    ];

    function missingWasmEngineAssets(dir: string): string[] {
      return WASM_ENGINE_ASSET_FILENAMES.filter((name) => !existsSync(path.join(dir, "wasm-engine", name)));
    }

    function wasmEngineGuardError(stage: string, dir: string, missing: string[]): Error {
      return new Error(
        `WASM-ENGINE-ASSET-ABSENT: ${stage}: missing ${missing.join(", ")} under ${dir}/wasm-engine/ — ` +
          "the wasm operation engine is required in browser mode (DEC-020 / ADR-0001) and no fallback engine " +
          "exists. Build it with `npm run build:wasm --workspace apps/desktop`, then rebuild."
      );
    }

    function wasmEngineDistGuard(): Plugin {
      return {
        name: "wasm-engine-dist-guard",
        apply: "build",
        buildStart() {
          const publicDir = path.join(desktopRoot, "public");
          const missing = missingWasmEngineAssets(publicDir);
          if (missing.length > 0) {
            throw wasmEngineGuardError("production build input check failed", publicDir, missing);
          }
        },
        closeBundle() {
          const distDir = path.join(desktopRoot, "dist");
          const missing = missingWasmEngineAssets(distDir);
          if (missing.length > 0) {
            throw wasmEngineGuardError("production dist output check failed", distDir, missing);
          }
        }
      };
    }

    export default defineConfig({
      plugins: [react(), wasmEngineDistGuard()],
      clearScreen: false,
      server: {
        port: 5173,
        strictPort: false
      },
      build: {
        rollupOptions: {
          output: {
            manualChunks(id) {
              if (!id.includes("node_modules")) return undefined;
              if (id.includes("/three/")) return "vendor-three";
              if (id.includes("/react/") || id.includes("/react-dom/")) return "vendor-react";
              if (id.includes("/lucide-react/")) return "vendor-icons";
              if (id.includes("/@tauri-apps/")) return "vendor-tauri";
              return "vendor";
            }
          }
        }
      },
      test: {
        environment: "jsdom",
        globals: true,
        include: ["src/**/*.test.{ts,tsx}"],
        setupFiles: "./src/test/setup.ts",
        // The App.test.tsx suite renders the full <App /> per case; under the
        // five-surface evidence sweep's machine load the default 5s test/hook
        // timeout trips a random handful of these renders (non-deterministic
        // failures, not assertion errors). Generous timeouts de-flake the suite;
        // a render that genuinely exceeds 30s indicates a real defect, not load.
        testTimeout: 30000,
        hookTimeout: 30000
      }
    } as UserConfig & { test: Record<string, unknown> });
